facts.business: Krystal Integrated Services Limited is one of India's leading integrated facility management service providers, delivering comprehensive services including facility management, manpower and staffing, private security, catering, waste management, and technical facility management across critical infrastructure such as airports, hospitals, metros, government institutions, and commercial establishments.
